$comment: Authoritative attestation reference for the production publicai-gateway CVM. Fetched at runtime by the /proof page. composeHash was read back from the CVM's RTMR3 event log on 2026-08-28 and cross-checked against the Phala control-plane API; both report a8f22490. Image digests are the linux/amd64 children of the cosign-signed proof-v18 indexes (sub2api INDEX 0e77241b, attestor INDEX 487e7397) built by publish-tee-images run 33148855149; the keyless signatures verify against certificate identity https://github.com/FiiLabs/sub2api/.github/workflows/publish-tee-images.yml@refs/heads/feat/two-sided-market, and the Fulcio certificates embed githubWorkflowSha = the sourceCommit below. This release is copy-only on top of proof-v17: the take-offline wording now states up front that an account stays offline until the provider puts it back, because a provider had to ask. The 10-minute window is a CANCELLATION window, not an auto-resume timer, and the asymmetry matters — someone who assumes it resumes on its own walks away and quietly earns nothing for days. proof-v17 itself carried the reference-source fix (this file used to be read from the proof-solo branch while images were built from feat/two-sided-market, so a healthy deployment could be reported as a TAMPERED enclave) plus the first-screen work: 1332KB -> 118KB (-91%) via disabling Vite's recursive modulePreload and serving build-time pre-compressed assets. The CVM runs 1 vCPU / 2GB. It was briefly scaled to 4/8 on a wrong diagnosis (TLS handshake CPU) and scaled back after measurement disproved it — handshake time did not improve at 4 cores; the real cause was download volume. osImageHash, appId and instanceId are unchanged; the deploy passed --no-dev-os explicitly, because phala deploy silently switches to a dev OS image when it detects a local SSH key and a dev OS would void the attestation.
